resources.string: A backup is one file with your library, reading positions, bookmarks, highlights, voice notes, pronunciation fixes, Up next and reading settings, plus books shared into Audora. Keep it somewhere safe, such as Drive or a computer.\n\nVoices and the dictionary are not included: download them again on the new phone. Books opened from your phone\'s storage come back once you add the same file again, with their positions and notes; watched folders ask to be picked again.
This replaces the library, notes and settings on this phone with the ones in the backup. Audora restarts to finish.
The backup couldn\'t be saved. Check there is space where you saved it and try again.
That file isn\'t an Audora backup.
That backup is from a newer Audora. Update the app, then restore it.
That backup is larger than Audora can restore.
The backup couldn\'t be read. Check there is free space on the phone and try again.
